user_query: I want to discover the top-rated TV shows of all time, including details like ratings, genres, and release years, and check their availability on TVDB.

TaskList.description: Search for top-rated TV shows using the 'Search by Title' API, retrieving details such as ratings, genres, and release years.
For each show found, check its availability on TVDB using the 'Get by TVDB ID' API.
